Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the summary and the MAP draft. We're aligned on most of this, but a couple of updates on our side after internal sync: 

- Timeline shift: Our finance lead informed me this morning that the FY budget review and procurement window moved - we are targeting execution in mid-May now (so target close will likely be ~2026-05-15).
- Security priority: Given our compliance calendar, we need the security review (SOC2 evidence and an artifact review) to happen earlier in the cadence and be a gating item for procurement. Can Redwood provide the SOC2 evidence packet and a short artifacts roadmap? If you can share the SOC2_Audit_Schedule.pdf and any sample evidence, that would speed internal sign-off.
- Procurement: Please loop procurement@novahealth.com on any legal/SOW questions. For planning, our procurement lead estimates 3 weeks from final SOW to signature (once SOC2 checks are satisfied).

If you can adjust the MAP to reflect a May target and move the security milestones earlier, that would be helpful. We still want to keep the technical eval but may run it in parallel with an earlier security check.

Best,
Sara Li
Director, Security & Compliance | NovaHealth
